quote: Starting as an operator gave me hands-on experience in operating and maintaining membrane systems. I have replaced membrane cassettes, modules, hoses, and valves, and made PLC programming modifications. For example, I enhanced MBR operations by implementing adjustable trans membrane pressure (TMP)-driven automatic backpulsing and modifications to automatic membrane flow control programming, which switches to influent flow when primary effluent flow metering is lost. Our team is constantly working to lower electrical usage and chemical cleaning cost. In 2007 our management team at the time implemented scour aeration programming changes that resulted in decreased cyclic air cycles and over 30% annual savings in electrical usage and reduced maintenance cost.
speaker: Mark Huggard, CMRT
